C1E1M07|lamp-lit.text: The lamp here is lit, Calder. Your father wrote that a lit lamp holds the tone back. I cannot say it does. I keep it lit.
C1E1M07|lamp-lit.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E1M03|start.text: Calder, the boardwalk will have Bellhands on it. Keep to cover.
C1E1M03|start.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E1M08|door.text: The whole stair is one corridor, going round and up. Nothing to find: just the way, and what is on it.
C1E1M08|door.speaker: INES

C1E1M08|warden.text: Another plate-bearer. Pillars in the corridor: that's your friend, again.
C1E1M08|warden.speaker: INES

C1E1M08|chamber.text: That's it: the ring of six bells, and the Cantor in the middle. The Bell is a machine, Calder. Cut the ring, then the singer. Use the pillars: the tone won't go through stone.
C1E1M08|chamber.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E1M08|quiet.text: The tower is silent, Calder, and the signal didn't stop. I have its bearing: the Salt Works. The hatch is open.
C1E1M08|quiet.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E2M01|exit.text: That's the way into the Works. After it, the Evaporation Pans: open flats and channels, and hunting parties.
C1E2M01|exit.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E2M02|start.text: White ground to the horizon, Calder, and one roof in the middle: the pump station. Everything between you and it is working.
C1E2M02|start.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E2M03|dock.text: Plate. The Warden-Graft again, and cradles all the way down the rail. Let it run into a pillar.
C1E2M03|dock.speaker: INES

C1E2M03|exit.text: The rail ends in Kiln Row. After this, the heat. Everything past that door is cooking something.
C1E2M03|exit.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E2M04|start.text: They fire the shells here, Calder. The flue is dampered shut and the handles are hidden. Brass first: the charging hall.
C1E2M04|start.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E2M04|flue-open.text: The flue is drawing. That's the cold coming up the stack. What they hid below the Works is colder than it should be.
C1E2M04|flue-open.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E2M05|start.text: This is where the grafts are made, Calder. Don't run, don't fire. Nothing in here is awake yet.
C1E2M05|start.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E2M08|start.text: Calder, the thing that runs the line is at the north end. Break its feeders first: they hatch its guards and half-shield it.
C1E2M08|start.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E3M05|start.text: Every door in there listens, Calder. Make a noise near one and it won't open for you until it has heard nothing for a while. Kill quietly, or wait.
C1E3M05|start.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E3M05|heart.text: Rows of them, standing, asleep: the ones the ship has tuned. If you can cross without a sound, cross. The lever is on the east wall.
C1E3M05|heart.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E3M06|ward.text: The tall one with the wheel of bells again. Everything near it takes half. It is behind the rows: go round the end of a pew and put it down.
C1E3M06|ward.speaker: HULL

C1E3M08|singers.text: Singers in the curve. A shell-back in front of them. Kill the tall one with the wheel first: everything near it takes half.
C1E3M08|singers.speaker: INES

C1E3M08|bell.text: Four-legged, a horn the size of a doorway, and it walks. Pillars are cover from the rings. While a reed sings it throws two: wait for the second.
C1E3M08|bell.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E4M02|start.text: Those are wrecks of earlier invasions, Calder. Step on a lit plate and it throws you across the gap. Steer a little, shoot as you go. If you miss, the sky puts you back.
C1E4M02|start.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E4M04|start.text: This is where the Gate is focused, Calder. Light does the work here. Use turns a mirror a quarter step. A mirror has a face and a back: light that meets the back stops.
C1E4M04|start.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E4M04|nw.text: Four chambers, screens between them. Light stops at a shut screen door. Light a receiver and the next door opens, for good. Then send the light on through it.
C1E4M04|nw.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E4M04|se.text: The corner mirror throws the light two ways: into a receiver, or on along the square. You will want both, one after the other.
C1E4M04|se.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E4M04|acolyte.text: Tall one with the wheel. Everything near it takes half. Kill it first. The mirrors can wait; they aren't going anywhere.
C1E4M04|acolyte.speaker: INES

C1E4M06|start.text: Five ranks, Calder, each a step higher, each with its own guard. The gaps in the screens don't line up. The tunnels in the flanks go round the first two.
C1E4M06|start.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E4M06|stalls.text: The stalls. A tall one with the wheel, and singers behind. Kill the wheel first. Everything near it takes half.
C1E4M06|stalls.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E4M08|start.text: Three seals hold its shield up, Calder: shoot them, or turn its own beam onto one with the plinths. Its eye opens before the beam. Stone stops it.
C1E4M08|start.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C1E4M08|mirrors.text: Mirror plinths, one-sided: a back stops the light. Use turns one a quarter step. Light off the face runs straight on, and there are seals on those lines.
C1E4M08|mirrors.speaker: HULL

C1E1S01|log1.text: First entry. The hum in the chalk. I knew it for what it was. Ines hears none of it: the ear I damaged by accident may be the best thing I ever did.
C1E1S01|log1.speaker: WARDEN CALDER'S LOG

C2M04|start.text: Terraces, and on every terrace a row of standing forks, brass and green, taller than a man. They are all humming. Not a sound I would put a word to.
C2M04|start.speaker: INES

C2M08|spire.text: A hollow spire, a round well in the middle of it and a stair going down the wall. Cold air comes up it, and a sound. I think that's what holds the Gate open. I am going down.
C2M08|spire.speaker: INES

C2M07|tally.text: THE MARROW ORDER. 311 BELLS CAST. 311 HUNG. FOUR SPARE.
C2M07|tally.speaker: BELLWRIGHT'S TALLY

C2M24|start.text: A long hall with every box I could want in it, laid out in two rows, as if somebody expected a person to come and take them. Somebody has.
C2M24|start.speaker: INES

C2M24|plate.text: OWED 52,310. SUNG 49,715. SHORT 2,595. It is the same plate as the one at the first fire-base, and the sum has not moved.
C2M24|plate.speaker: COUNT PLATE

C2M24|hollow.text: The wall of the top tier rings hollow behind the north pillar. There is a seam in it.
C2M24|hollow.speaker: HULL

C2M16|last-call.text: Calder, this is the last I can hold. The lamp is lit and the tea is cold. I'm here until the set goes.
C2M16|last-call.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C2M29|hush.text: It doesn't break. It hangs there, and the sound has gone out of the place as though the room had been unscrewed from the air.
C2M29|hush.speaker: INES

C2M30|deep.text: The city under the stone. Every lamp out, and one bell, high up, that nobody is ringing. It sways a little. I count three swings and then I stop counting.
C2M30|deep.speaker: INES

C2M30|door.text: A door that is also a bell. A hook beside it, the kind a lamp hangs from. My father said what a lamp is for. Light it, and keep it lit.
C2M30|door.speaker: INES

C2M19|thread.text: A thread, one voice to a cradle, cut to a length and laid in the weave. The plate counts the cradles in a night: four hundred and six. The Quiet One was right about the loom.
C2M19|thread.speaker: PLATE

C2M18|hollow.text: The rim wall rings hollow here. There is a seam in the bone.
C2M18|hollow.speaker: HULL

C2M20|hollow.text: The west wall of the west station rings hollow in one place. There is a seam.
C2M20|hollow.speaker: HULL

C2M25|seam.text: The outer wall of the last ledge rings hollow in one short run. There is a seam in the root.
C2M25|seam.speaker: HULL

C2M27|hollow.text: The wall of the north road rings hollow in one short run, in the first stretch. There is a seam.
C2M27|hollow.speaker: HULL

C2M28|hollow.text: The outer wall of the highest step rings hollow in one short run, east of the exit. There is a seam.
C2M28|hollow.speaker: HULL

C2M29|hollow.text: The wall of the top tier rings hollow in one short run, south of the middle. There is a seam.
C2M29|hollow.speaker: HULL

C2M30|lit.text: The bell on the door has gone quiet. It is holding.
C2M30|lit.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE

C2M22|bells.text: In the garden a tree of glass, and three chimes among the graves. Use the tree and it plays three notes; answer on the chimes in order, each within eight seconds of the last.
C2M22|bells.speaker: HULL
